fats: Egg Yolk (combination of good fats and protein)

recipes.title: Protein-Packed Chicken Salad
steps: Grill or bake the chicken breast until fully cooked.
Toss together chopped spinach, sliced avocado, and kiwi fruit.
Slice the cooked chicken breast and place it on top of the salad.
Dress with olive oil and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.

recipes.title: Salmon and Quinoa Bowl
steps: Bake or grill the salmon until it flakes easily.
Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Steam or stir-fry broccoli until tender.
Assemble a bowl with quinoa, salmon, and broccoli. Drizzle with olive oil

recipes.title: Egg and Veggie Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs and pour them into a heated pan.
Add chopped spinach, grated cheese, and sliced zucchini.
Cook until the eggs are set, and the filling is cooked.

recipes.title: Chicken and Sweet Potato Bowl
steps: Grill the chicken breast until fully cooked.
Roast sweet potatoes until tender.
Slice avocado.
Serve grilled chicken, sweet potatoes, and avocado over a bed of spinach/leafy greens.

recipes.title: Beef and Rice Stir-Fry
steps: Stir-fry lean beef strips until browned.
Cook long grain white rice.
Mix nut butter into the stir-fried beef.
Combine beef with rice, bell peppers, and broccoli.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese and Rice Cakes Snack
steps: Spoon low-fat cottage cheese onto rice cakes.
Top with sliced cheese.
Serve with sliced zucchini on the side.

recipes.title: Yogurt Parfait with Berries
steps: Layer yogurt with mixed berries in a glass.
Top with a handful of nuts.

recipes.title: Kangaroo Meat and Veggie Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Broccoli, bell peppers, and chia seeds

steps: Stir-fry kangaroo meat until cooked.
Prepare protein pasta.
Mix with stir-fried meat, broccoli, bell peppers, and sprinkle chia seeds.

recipes.title: Turkey and Tofu Skewers
steps: Skewer turkey and marinated tofu alternately.
Grill until fully cooked.
Serve with a side of roasted pumpkin.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Chicken with Asparagus and Cauliflower Mash
steps: Season chicken with lemon, garlic, and thyme; pan-sear until golden brown.
Roast asparagus with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Steam cauliflower, then mash with chicken broth and a touch of olive oil.

recipes.title: Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Quinoa
steps: Stir-fry beef in sesame oil, ginger, and soy sauce until cooked.
Add broccoli, carrots, and snow peas to the stir-fry.
Serve over cooked quinoa, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Mango Lime Chicken with Coconut Brown Rice
steps: Marinate chicken in mango puree, lime juice, and coconut milk.
Grill or roast the chicken until fully cooked.
Serve over coconut-infused brown rice, topped with diced red bell pepper, fresh cilantro.

exercise_descriptions.Flat Bench Dumbbell Press: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, press them up to the ceiling.
exercise_descriptions.Dumbbell Rows: Place one knee and hand on a bench, lift a dumbbell with the opposite hand, pulling it towards your hip.
exercise_descriptions.Dumbbell Shoulder Press: Sit or stand, press dumbbells overhead, extending your arms.
exercise_descriptions.Goblet Squats: Hold a dumbbell close to your chest and perform squats.
exercise_descriptions.Dumbbell Bicep Curls: Stand and curl the dumbbells, targeting the biceps.
exercise_descriptions.Incline Dumbbell Press: Similar to flat bench press but on an incline bench, targeting the upper chest.
exercise_descriptions.Bent-Over Rows (with Barbell): Similar to dumbbell rows but performed with a barbell.
exercise_descriptions.Lateral Raises: Stand and lift dumbbells to the sides, targeting the lateral deltoids.
exercise_descriptions.Lunges (with Dumbbells): Step forward or backward with one leg while holding dumbbells.
exercise_descriptions.Tricep Dips (using a bench): Place your hands on a bench, lower and lift your body to work the triceps.
exercise_descriptions.Decline Dumbbell Press: Lie on a decline bench to emphasize the lower chest.
exercise_descriptions.Single-Arm Dumbbell Rows: Stand and row a dumbbell with one arm, stabilizing yourself with the opposite hand on a bench.
exercise_descriptions.Step-Ups (using a bench): Step onto a bench with one foot, alternating between legs.
exercise_descriptions.Dumbbell Flyes: Lie on a flat bench, arms extended, and open and close the arms in a flye motion.
exercise_descriptions.Bench Press (with Barbell): Using a barbell, perform the classic bench press on a flat bench.
